body: Use case: stylized-concept. Create original Moonpetal GT 2000 sporty three-door liftback coupe game sprite sheet, 2994 salvage style. Reference for worn painted texture and transparent wheel cutout eight-view structure ONLY. A distinctly ANGULAR low wedge coupe, sharp pointed nose with tall swept triangular headlights running up hood edges, flat sloping hood, steep windshield, triangular rear quarter windows, high angular rear deck and narrow angular rear lamps. No rounded bubble roof, not same car as reference. One long side door and handle per side. Faded deep teal body with pale apricot replacement hood and ivory patch panels, restrained rust. No badges, words, manufacturer logos, racing kit or TRD parts. Eight consistent orthographic views four columns/two rows matching reference: front, front quarter nose left, side nose left, rear quarter nose right; rear, rear quarter nose left, side nose right, front quarter nose right. Wide3:1. Fully separated cars within cells. No wheels or tires, transparent wheel holes open through lower silhouette. Genuine transparent background, no scenery/shadows/text.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Moonpetal GT 2000 LEFT HAND DRIVE angular sport coupe cockpit dashboard overlay. Reference only for worn2994 salvage texture and overlay structure. Distinct angular charcoal driver-focused dash, deep teal fascia, pale apricot repairs, slim polygonal vents, narrow central radio and three climate knobs, angular passenger glovebox. Large completely BLANK OPAQUE BLACK driver binnacle LEFT around x220..760,y440..680 on1983x793canvas; no painted dials/gauges/numbers/text. Absolutely NO steering wheel/column/hands. Genuine transparent windshield above lowdashboard, only narrow far-edge sideposts, no roof/scenery/logos/text. Wide2.5:1, straight-on gamecockpit overlay. Crisp cleanalpha.
